reuse.why: Keeps using NO_SAVED_TEMPLATE and getCategoriesInFixedGroups and folds five identical category queries into one getFillableCategories helper, though copyPreviousMonth still applies the hidden rule with its own inline check over getBudgetData rows.

duplication.why: Removes four copies of the category SQL; the remaining duplication is the hidden-rule condition in copyPreviousMonth and the per-action repetition of the fixed/income skip loop, which pre-existed.

placement.why: The selection helper sits next to the other month-wide exclusion helpers in budget/actions.ts and the flag flows through the existing action argument objects (handler types derive via typeof).

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One function now owns the hidden filter for the query-driven actions, but the rule still lives in two forms (SQL fragment and the copyPreviousMonth row check), so a future change must remember both.
